item.title: Ask HN: How do you code review?
item.summary: In the past year, from my personal experience in 2 different companies, the amount of PRs has increased dramatically, and each PR is getting much bigger. How do you approach code review when dealing with large and high volume AI-generated code? Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49444984 Points: 3 # Comments: 2
